Brand: "{{brand_name}}"

The {{panel_finish}} panel shows honest use - a thumb smudge below the dial, a crumb caught in the seam, the printed legends slightly worn on the two most used buttons. Four thin {{accent_color}} ticks around the dial carry the labels "{{programme_labels}}". A bottom strip reads "{{spec_chips}}" and a small box at the lower left says "{{callout_text}}".
